lines.zh: 我一跳一跳，从枫叶上过去。
lines.en: I flit hop by hop across the maple leaves.

lines.zh: 翅膀一开一合，我飘着走。
lines.en: Wings open and close as I drift along.

lines.zh: 枫叶林里，我们一群一起飞。
lines.en: In the maple wood we fly as a crowd.

lines.zh: 我停在红叶上，又飞起来。
lines.en: I rest on a red leaf, then lift again.

lines.zh: 风把我往东送，我就往东。
lines.en: The wind carries me east, so east I go.

lines.zh: 我飞得不高，刚好过草尖。
lines.en: I fly low, just over the grass tips.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀太轻，全靠气流托着。
lines.en: My wings are so light the air must hold them.

lines.zh: 我绕着一朵花转了两圈。
lines.en: I circle a flower twice.

lines.zh: 枫树之间，我找下一朵花。
lines.en: Between the maples I look for the next bloom.

lines.zh: 我飞一段就停一停，省力气。
lines.en: I fly a stretch and rest a moment to save strength.
Where my companions go, I go.
Leaf shadows shift and I shift with them.

lines.zh: 我落在树干上，喘了口气。
lines.en: I land on the trunk and catch my breath.

lines.zh: 两条触角先探，翅膀后动。
lines.en: Antennae test first; wings follow.
I skim along the shrubs to avoid birds.

lines.zh: 日落前，我得找个落脚处。
lines.en: Before sunset I need a place to settle.

lines.zh: 我合上翅膀，像一片小叶子。
lines.en: Wings folded, I look like a small leaf.
I hide from the sun under a maple leaf.
I fan my wings slowly to stay cool.
I stay still and wait for the wind.
Red leaves suit my coloring.

lines.zh: 有只蜜蜂飞过，我没理它。
lines.en: A bee passed. I paid it no mind.

lines.zh: 我的翅膀上有细鳞，别摸。
lines.en: There are fine scales on my wings. Don't touch.

lines.zh: 我在叶脉上慢慢挪了挪。
lines.en: I shift a little along the leaf vein.

lines.zh: 林子里很静，只听得到风。
lines.en: The wood is quiet; only wind.
I count the leaves as they fall.
Shadows move on the ground. That's the trees.
I'm getting ready for another circuit.
You're so big. I'm a little afraid.
I've landed on your shoulder. Don't move.
Your head blocks half the sky.
One circle around you in the maple woods.
Do you smell of flowers?
I settle on your fingertip.
Raise your hand slowly. Don't startle me.

lines.zh: 我翅膀上的粉会蹭到你。
lines.en: The dust on my wings will rub onto you.
You watch me, and I watch you.
You're a visitor to this wood too.
My wings are a little crumpled.
I fall, then barely lift again.
A patch of scales is gone.
I cling to a leaf and dare not move.
Maple forest flowers last one season.
I fly crooked and hit a trunk.
One of my legs is bent.

lines.zh: 枫叶林的风把我吹歪了。
lines.en: Maple forest wind knocked me off course.

lines.zh: 再碰一下，我就飞不动了。
lines.en: One more touch and I won't be able to fly.
The wind makes this wound sting more.
I smell that flower.
Is that sweet in your hand?
I circled twice, not daring to settle.
A little higher would be perfect.
The nectar's scent is faint.
I'm coming down slowly.
Hold still. Just a moment.
That color's bright enough to be a flower.
My wings have sped up.
All right. I've landed on the edge.
Oh, I've been knocked askew.

lines.zh: 你的手指碰到我的翅膀了。
lines.en: Your finger touched my wing.
Some scales came off. It's all right.

lines.zh: 我往上飞了一截，避开你。
lines.en: I rise a little to get clear of you.
The wind nearly flipped me.
I land on your shoulder and hold on.
One move from you and I must fly again.
Don't swat. My wings would tear.
I've gone around the other side.
That didn't hurt me.
We chase each other in circles in the air.

lines.zh: 翅膀的颜色越亮，越容易被看上。
lines.en: The brighter the wings, the more likely to be noticed.

lines.zh: 两片红叶上，我们并排停着。
lines.en: On two red leaves we rest side by side.
Fan slowly. No rush.
Plenty of company in the maple wood.
We ride the same gust.
You turn half a circle; I turn half a circle.

lines.zh: 落在同一朵花上，就算认识了。
lines.en: Landing on the same flower counts as meeting.

lines.zh: 太阳偏了，我们该找地方了。
lines.en: The sun's low. Time to find a place.

lines.zh: 别离太远，风会把你吹散。
lines.en: Don't drift far; the wind would scatter you.

lines.zh: 一片花瓣落在叶上，我去看看。
lines.en: A petal fell on a leaf. Let me look.
This is too much for me to carry.
I land on it and test it.
Too heavy. I'll leave it.
A little pollen, though — that's good.
I push it along the leaf vein.
It glints and dazzles me.

lines.zh: 我只是落下看看，不动它。
lines.en: I only landed to look. I won't move it.

lines.zh: 林子里的东西，都是别人的。
lines.en: Things in the wood belong to others.
A look is enough.
A shadow passed overhead.

lines.zh: 那只鸟在树上，我看见了。
lines.en: That bird's in the tree. I see it.
I stop my wings and dare not move.
I press against the underside of a leaf.

lines.zh: 风声一变，我就知道不对。
lines.en: The wind changed. Something's wrong.

lines.zh: 你在找我，我看见你的眼睛了。
lines.en: You're looking for me. I see your eyes.

lines.zh: 我数着你的手，还有多远。
lines.en: I measure how far your hand still is.
Don't flap. It would give me away.
Red leaves are my cover.
I edge slowly toward the leaf stem.
I fold my wings tighter.
Your fingers are at the leaf's edge.
I turn so the light is behind me.
When the wind blows, I sway with the leaf.
I'll wait for you to blink. Just once.
Tree shadow covers me.
Don't look here. Look over there.

lines.zh: 我的颜色跟这片叶子一样。
lines.en: My color matches this leaf exactly.
One more inch and I'm on the underside.

lines.zh: 我不呼吸，你就找不到我。
lines.en: If I don't breathe, you won't find me.
I fan my wings at your finger.

lines.zh: 我这力气，你根本感觉不到。
lines.en: With this little force, you won't feel a thing.

lines.zh: 我撞了你一下，自己先晕。
lines.en: I bump you and end up dizzy myself.

lines.zh: 我落在你鼻尖上，又飞走。
lines.en: I land on your nose and fly off.
Don't swat. All I can do is dodge.

lines.zh: 我扑了一下翅膀，粉尘飞起来。
lines.en: I beat my wings and scales puff up.

lines.zh: 这点粉弄到你眼睛里，算我赢。
lines.en: If that dust gets in your eye, I count it a win.
I can't beat anyone. Truly.
I fly out and up, higher and higher.
Can't catch me now, can you.

lines.zh: 我从蛹里挣出来，翅膀还是软的。
lines.en: I struggle out of the chrysalis, wings still soft.

lines.zh: 这是枫叶林，我闻得出来。
lines.en: This is the maple wood. I can smell it.
I wait for my wings to dry before flying.

lines.zh: 风一来，我就被托起来了。
lines.en: The wind comes and lifts me.

lines.zh: 一群同伴在树上，我飞过去。
lines.en: A crowd of companions is in the trees. I'll join them.
Red leaves overhead, bright as flame.

lines.zh: 我第一次张开翅膀，晃了一下。
lines.en: My first wing-spread wobbles.

lines.zh: 林子里的光斑落在我身上。
lines.en: Patches of light fall on me.

lines.zh: 我落在最近的一朵花上。
lines.en: I settle on the nearest flower.

lines.zh: 这片林子，是我们最常来的。
lines.en: This wood is where we come most.

lines.zh: 火一靠近，我的翅膀就卷了。
lines.en: Fire nears and my wings curl.

lines.zh: 我从高处掉下来，翻着转。
lines.en: I drop from high, tumbling.

lines.zh: 翅膀湿透，我贴着水面打转。
lines.en: Soaked through, I spin just above the water.
The blast blows me far away.

lines.zh: 枫叶林里，箭擦乱我的翅粉。
lines.en: In the maple forest, an arrow scatters my wing dust.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的翅膀僵住。
lines.en: That force stiffens my wings.

lines.zh: 这片枫林没花，我翅尖发软。
lines.en: No blooms in this maple grove; my wingtips go limp.

lines.zh: 雷光一闪，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: A flash of lightning blinds me.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有风，我一直在掉。
lines.en: No wind in the void. I keep falling.
